analysis:
Examined both complete StartupPreload revisions and the ProviderLoop metadata/patch. ProviderLoop+StartupPreload.swift head:243,311-323 adds a stop-between-candidates predicate and stamps each candidate's time/generation; head:305-308 clears supervision state on completion. Existing serialized no-eviction loading, shutdown guards, self-test retirement/hash tombstones, and unadvertisement/reconnect behavior remain unchanged. No supported regression in model binding (T-012/T-027), cache isolation/encryption (T-041), prompt/key exposure, or connection authorization (T-053) is visible here. The current step is not newly cancelled by this file; the existing self-test timeout behavior is not a PR regression.
ProviderLoop.swift head:343-344,356-404 adds history detail, placement/hold state, download/inventory tracking, verification tasks, and transition-watchdog state. These declarations do not establish unsafe download, authorization, persistence, or disclosure behavior, but their consumers are outside this batch. Integration should examine AutopilotDownload/AutopilotPlacement, inventory-registration and policy-refresh implementations for operator consent, bounded disk use (T-016), verified weight binding, lease expiry/idle unloading (T-029), and diagnostic detail exposure (T-058). Review superviseTransitions and TransitionGenerations with StartupPreloader callback ordering: ensure a stall applies to the correct occurrence, cannot bypass failed-self-test retirement, and does not misattribute calibration/capacity work after the last candidate to a still-running candidate (head:282-308). Verify shutdown cancellation of the added candidate-verification/download tasks. These are unverified cross-file contracts, not observed missing controls; no finding is independently supported by this source scope.
